checkpoints.description: [1/1] port odd-pair fusion, induction strength reduction and bottom-test rotation; add fuse and final dumps to the parity gate and commit

impact_assessment.why: These were the last Python-only optimizer passes; the Rust optimizer is not complete until codegen sees the same transformed program.
impact_assessment.benefits: Full optimizer parity: 39/39 identical sources across every stage from lexing to final loop rewrites.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: shape guards, induction slot order and rotation rewrites must match; dependency: std-only Rust; concurrency: none; state: new Rust code, two oracles and ADR.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Compare canonical dumps over the corpus, run all gates before commit, and record the two bugs found by the gate.

checkpoints.description: [1/N] port the syntax-tree-to-bytes generator incrementally, beginning with the emitter framework, function frames, literals and simple expressions; each slice gets parity tests

impact_assessment.why: The last unported compiler component turns the optimized AST into x86-64 bytes; without it the Rust compiler cannot produce an executable.
impact_assessment.benefits: A Rust code generator producing the same machine bytes as Python, checked by dumping generated .text for real sources.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: every lowering rule, frame layout and calling convention must match byte for byte; dependency: std-only Rust; concurrency: none; state: new Rust module, oracle and ADR.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Port in small verifiable slices with a shared codegen dump over the corpus, run all gates before each commit.
